description_en: Seeks forward or backward in a video during playback
description_zh: 在播放视频时，可以调用此接口快进视频或后退视频
name: SkipVideoFile

parameters.help_en: The call ID. You can obtain the CallId from the response parameters of the SingleCallByVideo (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo) operation
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID。您可以在SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The time position to seek to for video playback. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 跳转到对应的时间播放视频，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: skip_times

parameters.help_en:
The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the receipt message.

The value is a string that is 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID。最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number that receives the video playback
parameters.help_zh: 接收视频播放的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number

Code.description_en:
The request status code.
OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful.
true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。
true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
